changes: Keep a Wake-on-LAN/WLAN device that is still activated after wake instead of taking it down and reconnecting it (the same patch as alarm-aurora and fedora-aurora).
notes: Not cross-buildable as Debian packages it: the introspection and documentation build needs python3-gi for the host architecture next to the build architecture's meson. alarm-aurora also carries Arch's GLib 2.89 test fix (NetworkManager MR 2548); Debian 1.58.1-1 already has it as Fix-test-suite-failure-with-glib-2.89.patch.
